description.value:
You have adopted the Life Domain as your chosen cleric domain (from a deity of healing, endurance, home, or the sun). All of this subclass's domain-dependent features draw on the Life Domain's benefits, granted at the levels below.

Life Domain spells (bless, cure wounds; lesser restoration, spiritual weapon; beacon of hope, revivify; death ward, guardian of faith; mass cure wounds, raise dead) become available to add to your spellbook via Arcane Initiate.
